§6Health Hazards§f

§aYour lungs don't appreciate coal dust. Or asbestos. Wear a mask.§f

NTM adds lung diseases that build up over time:

§6Black Lung§f: From coal dust when mining or handling coal. Builds to 72,000, then kills. Causes weakness and coughing at high levels. §bPrevention:§f Crude protective mask (damp cloth from wool + string soaked in water) works fine. §bCure:§f SiOX Cancer Medication or herbal paste.

§6Mesothelioma§f: From asbestos particles. Same 72,000 buildup, same death. Comes with a "entitled to financial compensation" message. §bPrevention:§f Gas mask with Particulates filter. A crude mask won't stop asbestos.

§ePS:§f Craft a crude mask before bulk coal mining. It's cheap and saves you a lot of pain.
